scenario: LGRA.2.9.6.8 — a `call` kwarg string value interpolates at runtime: `{s.obj}` substitutes into the call body delivered to the integrator. Pin: `call svc.do line: "cc {s.obj}"` reaches the cb with body `{line: "cc engine.o"}`.
rules_ds:
service svc.do:
    kwarg line: String
    no response

schema Src scope logical:
    obj: String key

rule r:
    Src s
->
    call svc.do line: "cc {s.obj}" nocooldown
